notes.title: Star Chef 2 Update
notes.notes:
* Time to fire up the stoves and sharpen your knives to feel the heat as Chef Masters become more intense and exclusive! Now compete against other skilled chefs in CHEF MASTERS, available only during Team Tournaments!
* Now Dish Mastery is linked exclusively to Chef Academy, so don your Chef’s Hat, grab your apron and get ready to master your skills and dishes together!

notes.title: Spring Festival Update!
notes.notes:
* Illuminated by lanterns, embellished by cherry blossoms, and enlivened by the infamous lion dance – SPRING FESTIVAL terrain.
* Ni Hao! Curious Kekoa is off to the Land of the Dragon to witness the infamous Chinese New Year. He’s got tickets for two, want to tag along?
* Let the blossoms of the Spring Festival take over your restaurant in the form of EXCLUSIVE decors.
* Gooey cupcakes, and crumbly cheesecakes, sounds yummylicious, right? Then you’ll love the brand new MINI-GAME BAKERY POP!
